in_sanskrit.name: Jarnail
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lion Brave
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jarnail एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jarnail is a Sikh name, derived from the word 'jarnail', meaning 'lion' in Punjabi. The name is a tribute to the bravery and strength associated with the animal kingdom. Jarnail is a revered name in Sikhism, often given to boys as a symbol of courage and valour.
